reviews.title: Subscription not working
reviews.text: I was really like this app, but not all of a sudden, premium features aren’t working. It says “is_premium required” when I have a yearly premium subscription that doesn’t renew until May 2027.

reviews.title: Great till it wasn’t
reviews.text: I loved this app when I first got it. I actually have a subscription till Dec. unfortunately the app has stopped working and you are unable to contact anyone to help you. Very disappointed…

reviews.title: It sucks
reviews.text: I didn't even get past the "your mood" part because the continue button was not on the screen

reviews.title: Update deleted my videos!!!!
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for YEARS and I loved it. I had a couple of videos on there. At some point, it automatically updated and it deleted ALL of my videos. I emailed them for help and I never got a response. When I wrote a review I got a response telling me to contact them through the app but there’s no way to do so. Very very disappointed

reviews.title: junk
reviews.text: expensive junk. won’t remember any settings if you close the app. have to reselect flash, camera type, aspect ratio every time. the app opens to library first, not to camera and you have to clock over every time. the icons for cam type it shows in screenshots aren’t actually in the app and instead are random line drawings that don’t tell you what kind of mode you’re in. just go spend $30 on a real digicam instead.

reviews.title: Too many in app purchases
reviews.text: While the cameras are kind of good, you literally have access to 2 free ones: not worth it

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: Didn’t get to even try the app, every time I tried to load anything from my media it would refuse to continue. It just hung, but it was still working because if I chose from camera it would open the settings up for that. On one of the newest iPhones, so not sure if it’s due to that?
